conditions.rationale: Discovery-only evidence: persistent-no-tested-localization-support owners are enriched in long same-description queues at the score-blind minimal-frontier context (29/38 versus 19/54 resolved-support owners), with the direction consistent across all six discovery images. Threshold 8 lies on a stable threshold-sweep plateau between the two stratum medians and above the native-TP calibration median.

provenance.selection_note: The score-derived owner competition margin was rejected as a rule condition because it is quasi-circular with calibrated peak_lift (discovery Pearson r approximately 0.935). Category routing, gate, raw score, and image-level context-count cuts were also rejected.
